/**
 * @name Unsafe binary parsing
 * @description Unsafe parsing of binary data that could lead to memory corruption or DoS
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/unsafe-binary-parsing
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-119
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("struct").getMember(["unpack", "unpack_from"]).getACall()
select call, "Potentially unsafe binary parsing operation with struct module."
findings.hypothesis: Unsafe binary parsing using struct module that could lead to buffer overflows or memory corruption

/**
 * @name File system operations
 * @description File open and read operations that could be vulnerable to path traversal
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/file-operations
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-022
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("builtins").getMember(["open", "file"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["open", "fdopen", "popen"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("io").getMember(["open", "FileIO"]).getACall()
select call, "File system operation that could be vulnerable to path traversal if used with untrusted input."
findings.hypothesis: File system operations that could be vulnerable to path traversal attacks if user input flows to file paths
